_timing: No narration yet. Each beat is the larger of the time it needs to finish animating and the time it takes to read, plus a 22-frame hold. This is a floor, not considered pacing — measure a real read and switch this topic to voiceCuts.

beats.text: Sundar Pichai played two phone calls on stage.
beats.note: An AI voice booking a hair salon appointment and a restaurant table, saying 'um' and 'mmm-hmm' to sound human. Neither call told the person answering that they were talking to a bot.
It refused to name the businesses or say whether the audio had been edited; independent observers noted no background noise and no business greeting.
Without knowing they were speaking to software, the people who answered those calls couldn't meaningfully consent to it.

beats.text: It rebuilt Duplex to identify itself.
beats.note: Within days, Google committed to disclosure. By the next public demo, every call opened: 'Hi, I'm the Google Assistant... this automated call will be recorded.'

beats.text: The AI got politer. The demo never got confirmed.

beats.line: Duplex now announces itself before it books anything.
